summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.39/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.39 a gallon across Wisconsin as of September 20, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the highest since May 19. AAA figures put the statewide average 34¢ higher than a week ago, 51¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.53 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($4.25) and the highest in Merrill ($4.52).
